boundary_before.domain: Bounded nonnegative linear sizes with constant multiplication and guarded subtraction; exact implication failure rejects rather than granting evidence; selected dyadic hierarchy profile. Raw proposals support Unit/Bit/Q<Bit>/products, ordinary calls, init0/H/X/CNOT/measure_z and exactly representable eighth-turn phases. The common selected CLI supports closed Raw run/sample and rejects any runtime parameter, including Unit, or quantum result. Explicit basis remains hierarchy-only. General basis/primitive/provider/branch capabilities, checked open invocation and final loader/checker/CLI convergence remain unfinished. The selected hierarchy admits recursive Unit/Bit/Bits/tuple bases, exact Op<tuple> binding and binary split/join with explicit unit/finish composition; direct phase_eighth remains atom-only. Finite unit/finish and selected coherent lifts are still unsupported, with no implicit profile retry.
boundary_before.limits: 64 modules; 65536 source bytes/module and 1MiB total; 10000 tokens/module; bounded syntax/type/scope, 1024 concrete calls/fold iterations, depth16/combined traversal64, 10000 ordered steps, 100000 value cells; existing downstream capacities independent Mixed Raw emission checks 16 globally live quantum wires across suspended calls and 10000 actual operations including expanded T gates before allocation/emission. Selected CLI samples1..1024; project samples1..1000000; Raw sample aggregate execution budget10000000, separate hierarchy execution limits unchanged. Recursive quantum bases retain 4096 nodes/depth64, at most eight axes per owner and sixteen in a frame. Actual retained basis nodes, including idle zero-width trees, are charged before event snapshot cloning; old atom costs are unchanged.
boundary_before.failure: Located syntax/name/type/ownership/effect/limit or preservation errors; observations cannot be retimed. CLI rejects ambiguous options, absent kernel and inconsistent bindings. Proposal-derived comparison requests are consistency fixtures, not independent algorithm contracts. Only an explicit typed hierarchy profile mismatch selects Raw under Auto; caller requests lock hierarchy, and unsupported whole-graph capabilities reject before native checking.
